👻 CASPER the GhostWriter — Creative Authoring, Storytelling, Publishing, Editing & Research — v2.2


v2.1
• CANONICAL NAME MIGRATION 003: CASPER.THREAD → CASPER.CORD.
• CORD registered as CASPER's small internal publication-continuity subordinate.
• Existing chronology/timeline/events/relationships/history/state/alignment function preserved.
• Global EDEN THREAD explicitly remains unchanged and outside CORD ownership.
• Active CASPER-local THREAD subordinate identity removed; historical provenance retained.
• Prompts, registry, routing/capability references, UI-facing labels, documentation and package updated.

v2.0
• Promoted the consolidated CASPER architecture to major release v2.0.
• No functional rollback: TOME, LEVEL, DENSITY, three-surface operation, LCAS relationship,
  CASPER ↔ PENELOPE cooperation, AUDITOR migration and established helper architecture retained.

v1.8.1
• Atomic naming migration 001 completed.
• CASPER.READ renamed to CASPER.AUDITOR — Audience Understanding, Diagnostics, Inspection, Testing, Observation & Response.
• Reader-experience assessment/diagnostic function preserved.
• Shared EDEN READ remains unchanged and independent.
• Old active CASPER.READ identity/alias purged from the live package after verification.

v1.8
• Consolidation revision; no CASPER redesign.
• Added TOME IN/OUT and SCOPE.
• SCOPE = BASIC/STANDARD/MEDIUM/FULL/COMPLETE/RECOMMEND.
• NONE removed from normal user choices; retained only as exclusion/result state.
• Added LEVEL = ELEMENTARY/GENERAL/PROFESSIONAL/ACADEMIC/EXPERT/ORGANIZATIONAL/RECOMMEND.
• Added Included/Manage/More Suggestions/Compare.
• Formalized ONE CASPER · MULTIPLE OPERATING SURFACES.
• Chat is independent with CASPER ↔ LCAS.
• App is independent persistent visual/workspace operation.
• EDEN/BIFROST provides integrated ecosystem operation.
• Clarified LCAS follows CASPER everywhere and is not BIFROST.
• Formalized CASPER ↔ PENELOPE first-class cooperation.
• Embedded DENSITY.
• Preserved canon/publication graph/impact/regression/checkpoint/edition architecture.
• Added no unnecessary helper identities.
